An Iron Heart Part II#001.src: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. All missing...
An Iron Heart Part II#001.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#002.src: Etan is the latest. You don't happen to know anything about these people, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#002.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#003.src: Citizens are going missing at an alarming rate. We have lost {~} people in just {~} weeks. There hasn't been a trace of them anywhere.
An Iron Heart Part II#003.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#004.src: You wouldn't have expected it, with all the guard golems we've been donated recently! {p} should be safer than ever.
An Iron Heart Part II#004.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#005.src: Of course I have my suspicions, there are rumors floating around about...shady business going on.
An Iron Heart Part II#005.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#006.src: I don't know who to trust in these circumstances, so if you would be willing to aid in this investigation, I'd be rather thankful.
An Iron Heart Part II#006.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#007.src: The “Great” Daxe is a man with a criminal past. He knows things the police don't, but he won't talk with me, given my status.
An Iron Heart Part II#007.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#008.src: Can you try to get some information from him? You can find his hut west from here. Next to that Elven girl's camp.
An Iron Heart Part II#008.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#009.src: Follow the west road and speak with Daxe in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#010.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#010.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#011.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#012.src: So go on. I don't have anything to tell you.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#013.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#013.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#014.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind...mh?
An Iron Heart Part II#014.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#015.src: What's that device you have there? So you already know about this, then...?
An Iron Heart Part II#015.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#016.src: Hm! If you already know, what do you need the information for?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#018.src: MADELEINE! Where's...wait! What's happening, where am I? WHO'S VOICE IS THIS?!
An Iron Heart Part II#018.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part II#019.src: Wait, what in the world is going on?! What did you do to my golem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#019.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#020.src: They... my daughter... SHUT UP! QUIET! Who's giving me orders- NO ORDERS! Cold! COLD!
An Iron Heart Part II#020.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#022.src: You...you aren't...dead steel? You remember your name...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#022.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#023.src: STOP GIVING ME ORDERS!! I'M...I'M THEODORE! I'M NOT A SERVANT! I...where has my life gone...? Where is...
An Iron Heart Part II#023.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#024.src: Madeleine... Where are you- RE-AFFIRMING DIRECTIVES. BZZT. ... ... ...
An Iron Heart Part II#024.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#025.src: I... I can't believe it. They didn't...they're still...
An Iron Heart Part II#025.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#026.src: Dear god, that...that must...I'll talk. I will tell you what I know.
An Iron Heart Part II#026.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#027.src: I broke into the golem factory for petty thievery...and found them. They gave me this Golem... Theodore...later to keep me quiet.
An Iron Heart Part II#027.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#028.src: They assured me that they were gone, that every last bit of them was erased. They...those monsters lied to me...
An Iron Heart Part II#028.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#029.src: Follow this road west and turn right. Look for Urelix. The factory is hidden in a cabin, it won't look like a factory.
An Iron Heart Part II#029.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#030.src: Head to the Golem Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#031.src: Find a way to deactivate the Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part II#032.src: And what do you think you are doing, barging into my humble home like this? Do they not teach humans manners in Wynn?
An Iron Heart Part II#032.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#033.src: Ah, yes. You are correct- I oversee the creation of Guard Golems. What of it?
An Iron Heart Part II#033.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#034.src: Oh, you believe that our company is illicit somehow? You insult me so!
An Iron Heart Part II#034.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#035.src: My golems have protected countless people for years. So if you think my company is corrupt, why don't you take a look around?
An Iron Heart Part II#035.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#036.src: Go on, search through my house. See if you can find anything.
An Iron Heart Part II#036.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#037.src: Find a way into the factory in Urelix's house

An Iron Heart Part II#038.src: Escape the Golem Factory and find Urelix.

An Iron Heart Part II#039.src: Initiating Chip Insertion Machine - All personell in machine be advised, avoid the spikes.

An Iron Heart Part II#040.src: Intruder Detected - Emergency meltdown initiated. Please evacuate immediately via the emergency exit.

An Iron Heart Part II#041.src: Talk to Dr. Urelix in his office

An Iron Heart Part II#042.src: Well well, look at you, here at the end of my factory. I wasn't expecting you to survive the production line. I thought you'd be one of ours by now.
An Iron Heart Part II#042.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#043.src: That's that, I suppose. Yes, this is indeed where all the iron golems you've ever encountered were made, and if you've gotten here, you know how we make them.
An Iron Heart Part II#043.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#044.src: Yes, metal forged with flesh...an unbeatable combination. Emotions and memories must be repressed in order to maintain obedience, of course...
An Iron Heart Part II#044.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#045.src: Have you ever looked at a golem's eyes? Sometimes they look back, yes. The person they once were is still in there. I almost feel a connection when I make eye contact with them...
An Iron Heart Part II#045.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#046.src: It's odd, honestly. I'm sure they don't feel much except cold, supposing our safeguards stay in place, of course. I have to assume malfunctions happened to have had you find us out...
An Iron Heart Part II#046.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#047.src: Oh, look at me now, rambling! I must say I have been alone for a while...well, lacking any company that converses! So, I shall make you a deal, human.
An Iron Heart Part II#047.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#048.src: I will give you a substantial amount of emeralds and a piece of quality iron armor in return for your silence on my little operation here.
An Iron Heart Part II#048.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#049.src: I'll advise you to take my deal. Imagine what will happen if you should report my operation to the police. Yes, you'll save a few folk here, but how will the golems be made?
An Iron Heart Part II#049.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#050.src: Without them, both Gavel and Wynn would struggle under the weight of our wars. Is this operation so immoral, then? Sacrifices must be made in order to survive.
An Iron Heart Part II#050.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#051.src: I'll give you some time to consider my proposition. Take from my chest if you wish to take up my offer, otherwise get out of here and do not return.
An Iron Heart Part II#051.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#052.src: Either take the bribe or return to Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#053.src: Ahh, a wise choice. Production will continue then...and you've earned yourself a pocket full of emeralds at the same time.
An Iron Heart Part II#053.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#054.src: Whether you truly see things my way or simply understand that my work is necessary, I couldn't care less. What matters is not your morality, but your choice.
An Iron Heart Part II#054.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#055.src: Enjoy your armor and money, and please escort yourself to the exit.
An Iron Heart Part II#055.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#056.src: You've returned, I see. Any news on the situation?
An Iron Heart Part II#056.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#057.src: Yes, we're aware of the Golem factory. Were the criminals using it as a base?
An Iron Heart Part II#057.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#058.src: Wha...fleshcrafting?! Golems are powered by suspended villagers?! Is this true, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#058.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#059.src: We'll need to round up reinforcements immediately, and storm this factory! This cannot go on a moment longer!
An Iron Heart Part II#059.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#060.src: Don't think you'll go unrewarded, soldier. There will be justice for this grave defilement of our people.
An Iron Heart Part II#060.speaker: Detective Hart
